en.headline: Police and Immigration arrest 19 mainland women in Yuen Long anti-prostitution operation
en.dek: Officers from the Yuen Long Police District Special Duties Squad and the Immigration Department detained the women, aged 21 to 51, for alleged breach of conditions of stay during a joint operation on Tuesday.
body: Police and the Immigration Department arrested 19 mainland women in Yuen Long on Tuesday during a joint operation targeting illegal prostitution activities.

The Yuen Long Police District Special Duties Squad, working with Immigration officers, conducted the operation code-named Flintstone. The women, aged between 21 and 51, were detained on suspicion of breaching conditions of stay. All were held for further inquiries.

Police said the district would continue to take firm action against illegal prostitution and related activities in the area. Members of the public were urged to report any suspected illegal activities to the police.

zh.headline: 元朗掃黃聯同入境處拘19名內地女子 涉違反逗留條件
zh.dek: 元朗警區特別職務隊聯同入境事務處周二展開行動，以涉嫌違反逗留條件拘捕19名年齡介乎21至51歲的內地女子，全部被扣留調查。
body: 警方及入境事務處周二在元朗展開打擊非法賣淫聯合行動，拘捕19名內地女子。
元朗警區特別職務隊聯同入境處人員進行代號「火石」的行動，以涉嫌「違反逗留條件」拘捕19名年齡介乎21至51歲的內地女子。所有被捕人現被扣留調查。
警方表示，元朗警區會繼續打擊區內賣淫等非法活動，並呼籲市民如發現懷疑非法活動，請與警方聯絡。
